'''S0-M1''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed at the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], S0-M1 relayed to Imperial forces an urgent transmission from [[Darth Malgus]] regarding the [[Cademimu uprising|situation]] on [[Cademimu V]].<ref name="TOR" />
